items.text: `dotenv get KEY --default VALUE` (decided 2026-11-04, uncommitted on branch `feature/get-default`): if the key is missing or valueless (a bare `KEY` line), it prints the default and exits 0. A key set to an empty string (`KEY=`) counts as having a value, so it prints empty and ignores the default. `--default ""` is honoured and prints an empty line. Without `--default`, a missing or valueless key still exits 1. A missing or unreadable env file still fails with exit code 2 even with `--default`, deliberately left unchanged as a different error. Motivation: scripts can fall back to a default instead of failing.

items.text: Documentation history in 2018-2019: docs moved from RST to Markdown in 0.8.2 (an RST-validation fix, #100, was reverted); a changelog, an `environs` mention (#127), and a testimonial were added; usage of `export` was clarified (closes #159); and a Python 2 special case for `__file__` was added (fixes #130).

Tests were made more robust and portable (2021-2022): built-in unittest.mock replaces the third-party mock, test_ipython is skipped if IPython is unavailable (#397), the existing environment is copied instead of overridden (keeping PYTHONPATH for Fedora/Gentoo packaging), and files like `.nx_file` are no longer left behind.

CI/CD supply chain was hardened (#650, May 2026): GitHub Actions pinned to full SHAs, top-level least-privilege permissions (contents: read) in test.yml and release.yml, pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish pinned to the v1.14.0 SHA, and dependabot extended with pip tracking, commit prefixes and labels. Dependabot bumps followed (#651, #652, #653, #658).

`dotenv run` was changed (July 2024, proposed by eekstunt) from `subprocess.Popen` to `os.execvpe`, replacing the dotenv process with the user's command. Rationale: no lingering parent process using RAM, and the command receives signals such as SIGTERM directly (important in Docker/containers). Behaviour is preserved since run only propagated the child's exit code. Later, in 1.1.1 (June 2025), execvpe was found problematic on Windows and `dotenv run` was fixed there.

Python version support history: Python 3.5 and 3.6 were dropped in July 2022 (#393, with tox and GitHub Actions upgrades); 1.0.0 (February 2023) dropped 3.7 and added 3.12 alpha (#449); 1.0.1 (January 2024) added Python 3.12 and pypy3.10 to the test runner; 1.1.0 (March 2025) added Python 3.13 support and dropped 3.8 (#551, fixes #550), and made find_dotenv reliable on Python 3.13 (#563). Also in 1.1.0, _is_debugger was added so load_dotenv works under pdb (#553).

Tests were made more robust and portable: use built-in unittest.mock instead of third-party mock, skip test_ipython if IPython is unavailable (#397), copy existing environment instead of overriding it (to keep PYTHONPATH for Fedora/Gentoo packaging), and avoid leaving files like `.nx_file`. | When: 2021-04 to 2022-04-07 | Involving: Michał Górny, Karolina Surma, Bertrand Bonnefoy-Claudet | Support distro packaging and avoid confusing test failures

items.text: CLI additions in 2018: the `dotenv run` command runs arbitrary commands with .env variables (#105), a `--version` parameter was added with the version stored in `dotenv/version.py` (#114), and the CLI was made an optional pip extra (#99).

Testing conventions (January 2020): tests go in the matching test file, logged warnings are checked, redundant lower-level properties are not retested, and the Arrange/Act/Assert pattern is followed with one thing tested per test, for clearer tests and easier failure interpretation.

README was rewritten (#294, by December 2020) around Getting Started, common use cases, CLI, file format, related projects and acknowledgements, with a table of contents added, based on user questions and feedback; docs for variables without value were improved (#390, March 2022).

set_key round-trips backslashes (#680, fixes #661, 1.2.3, August 2026): it escapes backslashes before single quotes when writing, and both single- and double-quoted parser patterns treat a backslash as escaping the following character, fixing values like C:\Users and trailing-backslash values that broke following entries.

Release 0.21.0 (September 2022): a fix for the out-of-scope 'dest' NamedTemporaryFile variable in rewrite error handling (#413) was added, then reverted due to a flake8 linter error, then re-applied later with a workaround (commit 1ecb57d).

The `PYTHON_DOTENV_DISABLED` environment flag disables load_dotenv (fixes #510, released 1.1.1 in June 2025). The same release switched to ruff for style, used sys.exit() instead of exit(), and fixed `dotenv run` on Windows where execvpe was problematic.

items.text: Type hints were added and exposed to users (2018-2019), with the `typing` dependency restricted to Python < 3.5. An argument to choose the .env file encoding was also added (default None; later changed to utf-8 in March 2021).

API/typing improvements (July 2021 and February 2022): `load_dotenv` and `dotenv_values` accept any text stream (`IO[str]`); `get_key`/`set_key`/`unset_key` gained an `encoding` parameter; untyped-defs checking was enabled in Mypy with types fixed, and Mypy 0.900+ is supported.

Python 2/3 compatibility and packaging work (2019-2020): the Python 2 unicode/str inconsistency of os.environ was fixed (#177) by encoding with `sys.getfilesystemencoding()` (UTF-8 fallback). `typing` is optional (#179), with a namedtuple fallback for Binding and tests run without it. Import errors on Python 3.5.0/3.5.1 were fixed, PyInstaller compatibility was added, `io.open` and UTF-8 were used in setup.py, and PyPI classifiers were fixed.

Parser fix (#663, closes #600, June 2026): an unquoted empty value followed by an inline comment (e.g. `KEY= # comment`) is parsed as an empty string rather than the comment text; `KEY=#novalue` and `KEY=a#b` are unchanged. The cause was the equal-sign regex consuming whitespace after `=`, so the comment-stripping rule did not match.

The `get` and `list` CLI commands report clearer errors (November 2022), e.g. a directory passed to `-f` yields 'Error opening env file: [Errno 21] Is a directory'; I/O was refactored to reduce system calls and race conditions.

Packaging was modernized (around October 2025): project metadata and config, including coverage, live in pyproject.toml with a declared build backend and builds via 'build'; setup.cfg was deleted and tox.ini fixed; PyPI publishing uses a trusted publisher. Versions 1.2.0 and 1.2.1 were released. The license specifier was first fixed to the table format (January 2026) to avoid pip build warnings; this was revised in September-October 2026 so project.license is now an SPDX string (#648), silencing the build deprecation warning. The test test_run_with_command_flags was also made portable (#709, fixes #708).

CLI enhancements (2021-2022): `dotenv run` gained a --override/--no-override flag (default --override); `dotenv get` now outputs only the value; and `python -m dotenv` execution was added (#395). Aim: make the CLI practical for scripts and optionally preserve existing env variables.

CLI `set` command changes (2020): gained an `--export` option to prepend `export` to the binding, and creates `.env` in the current directory if none is found. `set_key` escapes values before quoting, and `dotenv run` no longer crashes on variables without values (no-value keys are supported).

items.text: Test suite isolation (#160, related to #153, January 2019): tests use `dotenv_file` and `tmp_path` fixtures with unique, cleaned-up directories, so failing tests don't leave files behind and tests can run in parallel. `tmp_path` is preferred over `tmpdir` since `tmpdir` relies on `py.path` (maintenance mode).

Variable expansion was refactored (November 2020): parsing and expansion were decoupled into two steps (parse a value into atoms of literals/variables, then resolve to a string), and expansion order without override was fixed so e.g. URL=http://localhost:${PORT} resolves consistently with PORT, since a variable had been resolved inconsistently between two bindings.

Runtime issues such as a missing file are reported via the `logging` module instead of `warnings` (switched November 2019), because warnings expose library source to users, suit programming issues, and are noisy in tests. Tradeoff: harder testing on Python 2 (needs `mock`). The CLI may later use print or click.echo.

Write-path error handling was improved (September-October 2026): rewrite() no longer leaves a .tmp_* file or masks the original error when cleanup fails on Windows (#686); set_key and unset_key write errors now name the .env path (#711, fixes #710).

Release 1.0.0 (February 2023), bumped from 0.21.1, was a major release: it dropped Python 3.7 support, added Python 3.12 alpha (#449) with fixes for sh 2.*, handled a nonexistent cwd (#446; cwd issues seen with dynaconf when source directories are moved or deleted), and handled code imported from a zipfile (#456).

BREAKING change (January 2026): `dotenv run` forwards flags after the command to the wrapped command instead of interpreting them (e.g. `dotenv run ls --help` shows ls help). Flags for `dotenv run` itself go right after `run` (`dotenv run --override ls`); generic options go right after `dotenv` (`dotenv --file path/to/env run ls`).

items.text: Regex bug fix in 0.10.1 (#158, fixes #157, December 2018): `\s` matched newlines so the equal-sign matcher consumed them, making `FOO=\nBAR=b` parse as `[("FOO","BAR=b")]` instead of `FOO=""`, `BAR="b"`. The bug was introduced with the new parser.

`set_key` quoting was reworked (May 2021): `quote_mode` must be `auto`, `never` or `always`; surrounding quotes are no longer stripped; single quotes are used instead of double; and `auto` no longer quotes only alphanumeric values. Motivation: give users control over .env contents and avoid accidental interpretation of values by the parser or Bash.

Variable interpolation evolved between January and July 2020: control over interpolation was added (v0.11.0), Bash-like default values in expansion were added (v0.13.0), and interpolation order and duplicate-key handling were fixed (empty expanded value for duplicate key, v0.14.0). All bindings are now passed in order to interpolation instead of being deduplicated into a dict first, because deduplication left referenced keys undefined.

Version 1.2.4 was released on 2026-10-01 with fixes: dotenv get exits 0 for empty string values (#700, fixes #699), --no-override honored when expanding variables in dotenv run (#698, fixes #697), and inline-comment empty value parsing (#663).

CI and repo hygiene in spring 2024: Dependabot added to keep GitHub Actions up to date, test.yml multiline string fixed with a fail-fast: false strategy (#514), a security policy added, and docs clarified for default load_dotenv behaviour (closes #457).

Supported Python versions: Python 3.9 support was dropped in January 2026 (EOL October 5, 2025); minimum is now Python 3.10 (requires-python >=3.10). Officially supported are CPython 3.10-3.14 and PyPy 3.11 (PyPy was updated from 3.10). Tox has separate py314 and py314t environments, and CI tests the free-threaded Python 3.14t build.

items.text: Version 0.10.0 was released on 2018-12-05 (version bumped 0.9.1 to 0.10.0, release notes added), followed by 0.10.1 on 2018-12-14 (changelog updated, bumped from 0.10.0).

The default `encoding` for `load_dotenv` and `dotenv_values` changed in March 2021 to "utf-8" instead of None (locale-based), because a project file like .env should not depend on user locale. It is breaking only for users with non-UTF-8 locale and non-UTF-8 .env files; Flask and Docker Compose already enforce utf-8.

Parser bug fixes between November 2019 and September 2020: malformed lines print a warning on stderr while parsing continues; comment-only lines no longer trigger warnings (Binding gained an `error` field so it can distinguish comment-only from malformed lines); unquoted values with two or more adjacent spaces/tabs parse correctly; a warning on a trailing empty line was removed.

A leading ~ is expanded to the user's home directory in dotenv_path for load_dotenv, dotenv_values, get_key, set_key, unset_key and the CLI --file option (#615, fixes #525), and in find_dotenv and the IPython %dotenv magic (#714); September-October 2026.

Version 1.0.1 (January 2024) fixed a Windows error where a temp file was deleted before being closed in the rewrite function (#468), and allowed modules using load_dotenv to be reloaded in a separate thread (#497, is_interactive update).

items.text: Parser overhaul in python-dotenv 0.10.0 (PR #148, December 2018): parsing is no longer line-based (`parse_line` replaced by `parse_binding`), parsing code is deduplicated into one place, and `get_stream` became a context manager. It added support for multiline values (#89), backslashes in values (#112), trailing comments (#141), and unquoted UTF-8 values (#147), superseding PR #142. Centralizing parsing makes it easier to change, test, and support multiline bindings in the CLI. This parser was later refactored into a handwritten top-down parser in 2019 (#180).

python-dotenv dropped Python 2 support ('Require Python >= 3.5', fbc7a63, June-July 2021), simplifying code, enabling features and lowering the barrier to contributions. Follow-up cleanups removed Python 2-specific code (`to_env`/`to_text`), 'coding: utf-8' declarations, unnecessary future imports and typing guards, and adopted Python 3 type hints and `str` instead of `Text`.

Parser architecture: in May 2019 (#180) the single large regex parser was refactored into a handwritten top-down parser built from smaller regexes, in a separate module, because one regex could not satisfy the parsing requirements. This fixed post-0.10.0 inconsistencies (escapes interpreted in single-quoted strings, and `#` starting a comment without preceding whitespace); escape interpretation in double-quoted strings was kept.
Parser recovery handles CRLF invalid lines, and a test verifies line numbers after CRLF parser recovery (#669, October 2026).

items.text: Proposal to change `dotenv run` CLI from `subprocess.Popen` to `os.execvpe`, replacing the dotenv process with the user's command. Benefits: no lingering parent process using RAM, and the command receives signals like SIGTERM directly (important in Docker/containers). Behaviour is preserved since run only propagated the child's exit code. | Involving: @eekstunt | Avoid hanging parent process and improper signal handling in production/containerized environments
